name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon rests on a dais of gold amid its treasure, wings partly unfurled to catch the light, head raised and turned toward the camera with a serene, luminous gaze.
components.background: the ruined nave of a vast cathedral open to the sky, soaring white stone arches, tall stained-glass windows casting colored light, golden shafts of sun and drifting incense
components.hoard: piles of gold and rose-gold coins, jewelled reliquaries and chalices, shards of stained glass, polished mirrors and golden candelabra, radiant crowns and sunburst medallions
components.effects: Soft golden motes drift through the shafts of light like dust in sunlight - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
